info.description: What people can book and pay for on the consultation page: the base package, its add-ons, and the long-term programs.

titleFr.description: Optional. The French site shows the English title if this is empty.

kind.description: base: the starter package. addon: an extra people can add to the base package. program: a long-term program (3, 6 or 12 months).

months.description: Programs only: how many months. Shown as a badge and used for the per-month price.

includes.description: What is included. One item per line.

includesFr.description: French version. One item per line.

priceInr.description: Rupees, e.g. 4900. For an add-on, the extra amount.

priceEur.description: Euros, e.g. 165. Leave empty to not offer it on the French site.

active.description: Untick to hide it from the website without deleting it.
